LESSON: SAUM • TYPES OF SAUM (FARDH, SUNNAH, NADHIR, KAFARA, QADHA),

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.3: Saum • types of Saum (Fardh, Sunnah, Nadhir, Kafara, Qadha),
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Saum • types of Saum (Fardh, Sunnah, Nadhir, Kafara, Qadha),, part of Devotional Acts in Grade 7 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What are the benefits of Saum in the life of a Muslim?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe types of Saum for ease of observance

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Saum • types of Saum (Fardh, Sunnah, Nadhir, Kafara, Qadha), in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. assess the significance of Saum for spiritual growth,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Saum • types of Saum (Fardh, Sunnah, Nadhir, Kafara, Qadha), in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. observe saum to earn rewards from Allah,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Saum • types of Saum (Fardh, Sunnah, Nadhir, Kafara, Qadha), in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate the observance of Saum as a way of earning taqwa.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Saum • types of Saum (Fardh, Sunnah, Nadhir, Kafara, Qadha), in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. describe types of Saum for ease of observance

   Saum • types of Saum (Fardh, Sunnah, Nadhir, Kafara, Qadha), helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. assess the significance of Saum for spiritual growth,

   Saum • types of Saum (Fardh, Sunnah, Nadhir, Kafara, Qadha), helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. observe saum to earn rewards from Allah,

   Saum • types of Saum (Fardh, Sunnah, Nadhir, Kafara, Qadha), helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. appreciate the observance of Saum as a way of earning taqwa.

   Saum • types of Saum (Fardh, Sunnah, Nadhir, Kafara, Qadha), helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

E. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss the types of Saum, make charts, and present in class

2. research on the significance of Saum and present on PowerPoint /charts in groups

3. compose a poem on Saum and make a class presentation.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss the types of Saum, make charts, and present in class
2. research on the significance of Saum and present on PowerPoint /charts in groups
3. compose a poem on Saum and make a class presentation.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Saum • types of Saum (Fardh, Sunnah, Nadhir, Kafara, Qadha), together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: the skill of listening, speaking, writing and teamwork as learners discuss types of Saum

in pairs or groups.

• Digital Literacy: the skill of interacting with digital technology as learners research on the significance of Saum.

• Creativity and Imagination: as learners network to compose a poem on Saum.

Values:
Responsibility: accountability through research on the significance of Saum.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Lifestyle diseases: awareness is enhanced as learners research on the significance of Saum.

Link to other subjects:

Integrated Science: as the learners discuss the significance of Saum in groups, they relate to knowledge of health education in

Integrated Science.
